name: What U Need?
overview: Beta 1: catalog requests, series coverage and episode details. Linux x64 only.
description: Search the installed TMDb provider, request movies or episodes, follow requests and review administrator decisions. Details include synopses, title and season covers, episode stills, availability and provider dates. Administrators approve, decline or defer requests and keep private notes. Acquisition is manual; automated monitoring workers are not included. Tested on Jellyfin 12.4.0 / Linux x64 only. Requires Plugin Pages and File Transformation 3.0.3.0 Release-12.4.0 builds. Portuguese/English with English fallback. Back up before installing.
